latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of clawflows skill, enabling multi-skill automations via ClawFlows.com.

- Search, install, and run automations combining multiple skills and capabilities.
- Supports portable workflows using abstract capabilities (e.g., youtube-data, database, chart-generation).
- Includes CLI for managing automations (search, install, run, schedule, logs, publish).
- Integrates with SkillBoss API Hub for AI features (TTS, LLM, image generation) via SKILLBOSS_API_KEY.
- Provides instructions for making custom skills and capabilities ClawFlows-compatible.
